tests.name: dependency_imports
tests.evidence: Torch, Transformers, Lightning, TorchMetrics, OmegaConf, and Pillow imported successfully.

tests.name: upstream_config_parse
tests.evidence: WikiMEL YAML parsed with 109976 entities, batch size 128, and 20 epochs.

tests.name: model_construction
tests.evidence: MIMICEncoder and MIMICMatcher constructed with 151715876 parameters.

tests.name: primary_qid2id_load
tests.evidence: The loader now uses json.load(f) and loaded all 109976 entries from the canonical pretty-printed map.

tests.name: qid2id_read_only_shim
tests.evidence: The source single-line qid2id is structurally identical to the canonical map: 109976 entries.

tests.name: clean_loader_inventory
tests.evidence: Loaded 18092 train, 2083 development, 4000 test, and 109976 entity rows.

tests.name: first_train_collation
tests.evidence: Batch size 2 produced fp32 mention/entity images [2,3,224,224] and text IDs [2,40].

tests.name: repeat_train_collation
tests.evidence: Train, evaluation, and entity collators each accepted the same two cached samples twice without mutation and returned batch size 2 both times.

tests.name: fp32_cuda_forward_backward
tests.evidence: Finite loss 3.4657459259; fp32 parameters; peak allocated 1365.32 MB and peak reserved 1512.00 MB for batch size 2.

tests.name: lightning_one_batch_fit
tests.evidence: Trainer.fit completed one fp32 GPU batch with loss 1.38 under Lightning 1.9.5.

tests.name: deterministic_missing_image_pixels
tests.evidence: Missing and corrupt images use zero tensors, not random pixels.

tests.name: missing_image_mask_semantics
tests.evidence: Mention/entity flags now propagate through train, validation, test, and cached entity paths. Missing encoded visuals are exactly zero; invalid visual pair scores are exactly zero and their aggregate score equals the text-only score.

tests.name: test_isolation
tests.evidence: codes/main.py gates trainer.test behind run_test_after_fit, which is false in both experiment configs and defaults to false when absent.

tests.name: sanitized_visual_config
tests.evidence: Full and one-epoch debug configs point to clean_sanitized_visual, use precision 32, 109976 candidates, evaluation chunk size 5000, seed 43, and disable test-after-fit.

tests.name: deterministic_cuda_startup
tests.evidence: CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8 is set before importing Torch, satisfying deterministic CUDA execution.

tests.name: post_fix_lightning_one_batch_fit
tests.evidence: A real fp32 CUDA Trainer.fit completed one patched configured-size batch (64) with finite loss 41.2; peak allocated VRAM was 8582.84 MB.
